exposure: Maternal infections during pregnancy requiring hospitalization
Early childhood infections during the first year of life requiring hospitalization
cohort: The study included 2,885,662 individuals (comprising 1,864,660 full siblings) born in Taiwan between 2001 and 2018.
finding: Maternal infection during pregnancy's association with offspring neurodevelopmental risk was largely explained by familial confounding, whereas early childhood infections independently increased the risk of ASD and MR.
